en: You're looking a little... pale. You must have caught that disease...
Don't worry, I know how to look after people.
I'm not like that alchemist charlatan!
He has no idea what he's doing...
I'm a man of science!
Right, come here and relax - this might sting a little.
There we go! Feeling better now?
What? A little bloodletting always does the trick!
Oh, now don't be like that!
Here, have some candy, it's on the house.
We really need to go!
Evil doesn't wait!
I see you are a specialist. Your scarf is there to protect your neck from bitings, am I right?
If you see Maria, tell her that I won't be able to feed her cat this week.
I'm free, at last! Thanks again!
I'll have to fight him once again... It doesn't bode well.
Did you meet Alucard on your way to the Castle? He's a precious ally when it comes to fighting his father!
My last fight with Dracula was gruelling...
Hey, it's you! Thanks again for freeing me, my decomposed friend!
Sadly, I won't be able to join you either. Dracula drained all the strength out of my body during our previous fight... Kill him for me, okay?
Seems being cursed isn’t all bad...
I've heard the monsters get nastier and nastier as you get closer to the end...
Apparently there are things hidden in the walls... Might REALLY be worth taking a closer look.
So you've come in search of a little challenge?
Here, only the best of the best...
The crème de la crème...
Or should I say, the ELITE OF THE ELITE... can manage to rack up a respectable score!
Do you think you're up to it?
In that case, head down and defeat this level's boss as fast as you can while scoring as many points as you can manage.
You'll find some equipment to help you along the way, but some objects may be forbidden.
The Collector might have something to do with that, who can say...
And don't forget, the shortest path isn't always the best...
Dead again?
You weren't all that good now were you...
I've noted your... "achievements", if that's what you want to call them.
You. Back again. Of course.
You really aren't getting any better are you?
Bring it back to me quick!
It's somewhere around here! I know, I can FEEL it!
Did you find it?
Oh, where are you, my precious little rune?
So? Have you got it?
Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
You're not gonna get the... my rune back by hanging around here...
A little courage, my man!
Show a little nerve!
You wouldn't abandon a friend in need, now would you, huh?
There's no one there...
There's no one...
HEY YOU!
Come here a second!
A little slow... But you seem to understand what I'm saying...
I lost a ru.. I mean MY rune. So you see, I'm a little stuck...
And I NEED my rune, you see...
You wouldn't mind finding it for me, would you?
Ho ho! Thank you! It's somewhere around here in these sewers, on your side of these bars...
Aha! There you are!
It's here! The... MY rune is just a little bit further on!
What? Not at all, nothing to worry about!
After coming this far, you’ll make short work of all that!
So... OFF YOU GO!
Hey, over here!
I saw your fight. It was pretty impressive.
Did you...? Did you get it?
Excellent! Now give it to me!
I said...
GIVE IT TO ME!
I knew it... You're just like all the rest...
You'll regret this...
GIVE ME THE RUNE!
It's MY rune!
MINE!
GRR!
COME ON!
I WANT my rune!
I'll get my rune back, you'll see...
I'll get it back, you'll see...
You’ve nothing to lose by waiting...
Greetings... I am... Neow...
Reach the City to... wait, what... is this place?
You look... different... where are your... cards?
Here... take this Prismatic Shard deck...
A little bit of this... a little bit of that...
At last!
Come closer! I won't cut you, don't worry.
I'm the tailor. I can fix you up with some proper clothes!
I struck a... deal with our mutual friend, the Collector.
You bring him the templates and I will craft it for you!
Ah, here comes my favorite customer! Know that your loyalty does not go unnoticed!
Here, take a pair of collector edition scissors as a thank you!
Oh, here you are! I actually wanted to say that...
Your sense of style is so inspiring! I'd love to be just like you when I turn... dead?
Here is a token of my admiration! Use it to comb-o through your enemies!
You look... SPLENDID!
FA-BU-LOUS!
If only Karl could see you!
A great choice! It really brings out your eyes.
Hey, I've got new heads for you.
No, I don't reveal my name to any random walking corpse I meet, sorry.
Eww ! Look at you! Someone needs a good combing!
Hey, I've got a new technique to try out. Can I borrow your head for a bit?
Nothing to do... I'd almost regret my classes...
Oh no, I can't comb this!
